changelog:
Initial release: Enables publishing and updating websites with Revdoku, supporting both static and interactive app sites.

- Publish folders as public or password-protected websites using revdoku CLI.
- Supports per-bucket server databases for app features (e.g., feedback, search, notifications).
- Private storage and draft publishing available via CLI options.
- Binary assets upload directly via CLI/REST API; file tools are text-only.
- Promotes MCP tools for text file operations and bucket management when server-connected.
- Clear guidance on Revdoku capabilities and limitations for website hosting.
